title: Medicare Advantage cuts leave millions scrambling to find coverage
summary: Private insurers are pulling out of some Medicare Advantage markets or dropping popular plans, leaving many older Americans facing higher costs or lost coverage. Three seniors describe rising copays, cancelled plans and how hard it is to compare options. Health-care journalist Dan Weissmann explains why insurers drop unprofitable plans, why switching back to traditional Medicare can be difficult, and what people should do quickly.
focus: Shadow Dan Weissmann's explanation of how private insurers decide which plans to keep: lively, idiom-rich, plain-English explanation of a business model, with great informal phrases.
